description: Source code for wake word detection and processing in Swift, including data structures for segments, configuration, matches, and the main logic for matching wake words within transcribed speech segments.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of transcribed speech, including text, timing, and optional range information.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Main function to find a wake word trigger match within transcript segments based on provided configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Generates the command text following a trigger end time from the transcript segments.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if any trigger token appears within a given text string.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger tokens from the start of a text, effectively stripping wake words.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts an SFTranscription object into an array of WakeWordSegment objects.
